name: 💳 Payment Reminder (Polite)
description: Gentle reminder for amounts due within 7 days
body:
Hello {{customerName}} 🙏,

Hope you are doing well!

This is a gentle reminder from *{{shopName}}* that a payment of *₹{{amount}}* is pending against your account.

Due Date: *{{dueDate}}*

Kindly clear the dues at your earliest convenience. For any queries, feel free to contact us.

Thank you for your support! 🙏

— Team {{shopName}}

name: 🚨 Payment Reminder (Urgent)
description: Urgent reminder for overdue payments (7+ days)
body:
Dear {{customerName}},

⚠️ *URGENT PAYMENT NOTICE*

Your payment of *₹{{amount}}* to *{{shopName}}* is now *{{daysPastDue}} days overdue*.

We request you to please clear this immediately to avoid any inconvenience.

📞 Contact us immediately if you have already made the payment.

Regards,
*{{shopName}}*

name: 🎉 New Offer / Sale
description: Send promotional offers and discounts to customers
body:
Hello {{customerName}}! 🎉

Exciting news from *{{shopName}}*!

🛍️ *SPECIAL OFFER FOR YOU*

{{offerDetails}}

⏰ Valid till: *{{validTill}}*

Don't miss out! Visit us or contact us today.

Happy Shopping! 🛒

— Team {{shopName}}

name: 🪔 Festival Greeting + Offer
description: Festival greetings with special discount announcement
body:
🎊 *{{festivalName}} Mubarak!* 🎊

Dear {{customerName}},

Wishing you and your family a joyful *{{festivalName}}* from all of us at *{{shopName}}*! 🙏

🎁 To celebrate, we are offering *{{discountPercent}}% OFF* on all products!

Come visit us and make this festival extra special.

With warmth & gratitude,
*Team {{shopName}}* 🌸

name: 📦 Order Ready / Bill
description: Notify customer that their order is ready for pickup
body:
Hello {{customerName}}! 👋

✅ *Your Order is Ready!*

📦 Order Details:
{{orderDetails}}

💰 Total Amount: *₹{{totalAmount}}*

Please visit *{{shopName}}* to collect your order at your convenience.

Thank you for shopping with us! 😊

— {{shopName}}
